name: Cable Seated Reverse-Grip High Row
steps: Sit tall facing a high pulley with your feet braced and knees softly bent.
Reach upward to take an underhand palms-up grip on the bar about shoulder-width apart.
Drive both elbows down and back close to your sides to pull the bar toward your ribs.
Squeeze your back briefly, then extend your arms along the upward cable path under control.
tips: Keep your palms turned toward you without bending your wrists.
Keep your chest upright and avoid rocking backward to start the pull.
